_comment: Overlay on packages/maker/config/default.json for the Cloudflare Worker. Operator and market-creator caps mirror the Mac's go-live config/local.json, but the roll has its own meter (rollCapMon) so quoting can never starve the next day's roll (the 2026-10-08 incident): roll 0.8. Measured roll costs at 102 gwei: maker ~0.48 + opening quotes ~0.3, operator createLadder 0.12 + 4-5 x setCanonical 0.014, market creator 4-5 x deployProxy 0.15. Quoting cap maker 6.9 = CUTOVER DAY ONLY (2026-10-09 Taipei): import-state re-books the Mac's quote+pull spend of that day onto this meter, and the Mac's own meter stops at its cap 4.5 + 0.2 pull reserve = 4.7 (it was at 1.56 by 02:21 Taipei, spending ~0.65 MON/h, so it reaches its cap before the 07:00 cutover window); 4.7 + the Worker's usual 2.2 for the rest of the day = 6.9. Lower it back to 2.2 from 2026-10-10 (docs/OPERATIONS.md 8.7). policy.requoteTicks 3 (Mac: 2): with the guard-wide hysteresis (default.json fair.guardWarnExit 0.13) it cut re-quotes from 44 to 17 in a replay of the Oct 9 ladder (docs/OPERATIONS.md 8.7). Vars in wrangler.toml (STATIONS, RPC_URL) and CONFIG_OVERRIDES override this file.
